question: What is the default file format for saving workbooks in newer versions of MS Excel (e.g., Excel 2019)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**.xlsx**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **.xlsx** format is the default file format used in newer versions of **MS Excel**, such as Excel 2019 and later.
 
• **.xlsx** is based on the **Office Open XML** standard, which is a more efficient and secure file format compared to older formats.
